title: AI Dashcam: Smarter Driving with Event Analysis #shorts
description: AI analyzes camera footage to detect objects, estimate depth, and build 3D reconstructions of driving events. This creates a coaching workflow for drivers, simulating real-world scenarios. #AIDriving #ObjectDetection #3DReconstruction #DriverCoaching
